tool_args.rationale: All five pilot horizons are at or below 0.48, while the forecast horizon is 20.4. The slow-horizon probe directly tests whether adaptation bends or reverses the positive pilot response before fitting the sink-coupled law.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled adaptation law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons the slow term mainly constrains the ratio of adaptation amplitude to slow time constant, not the two separately. A good pilot fit would not establish accuracy at H = 20.4.
It shares the slow-timescale ambiguity and omits the observed sink-gradient signature.
It costs only 0.5 less but is not targeted at the missing long-horizon response.
